tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the AgentRoam travel-crypto catalog: gift cards (Airbnb, Uber, airlines, 500+ US brands), eSIM data plans (110+ destinations incl. Europe/Global region plans) and mobile top-ups (carriers in 100+ countries). Returns product handles for get_price/validate_order. Never creates an order.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Live crypto price for one product/denomination. Payment coins include USDT, USDC, BTC (incl. Lightning), ETH, SOL, DAI, PYUSD, LTC, TRX, TON, DOGE and SUI across many networks — call get_payment_methods for the current list. Never creates an order.

tools.name: validate_order
tools.description: Dry-run an order and mint a one-time confirm_token (valid 10 minutes). Returns a human-readable summary that MUST be shown to the user for approval before calling create_order. Does NOT create the order or reserve funds.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create the real order (requires confirm_token from validate_order, after user approval). Returns the payment wallet address, exact crypto amount, 30-minute expiry, and an order-status URL. The purchased code/QR is emailed by Cryptorefills to the buyer — it is never returned here.

tools.name: list_esim_plans
tools.description: PREFERRED for any eSIM request: live eSIM data plans for a destination (110+ countries, plus "eu" Europe and "ww" Global multi-country plans) with USD prices and crypto amounts. Renders an interactive plan-picker widget where the user can complete the purchase directly. Never creates an order by its

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Poll order state (WAITING_FOR_PAYMENT → PARTIAL → COMPLETED, or CANCELED/EXPIRED). Requires the status_token from create_order.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: Browse all available brands/carriers for a country: gift cards (500+ US brands) and mobile top-up carriers (100+ countries). Never creates an order.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List a brand's live products/denominations with prices in the chosen coin — exact labels to use with get_price/validate_order (for eSIM use list_esim_plans instead). Never creates an order.

tools.name: get_currencies
tools.description: List all supported payment cryptocurrencies (the response carries the current set).

tools.name: get_payment_methods
tools.description: Full payment matrix: every supported coin × network combination currently available, with the exact network strings orders require. The response includes live totals — report those, never a memorized count.

tools.name: purchase_wizard
tools.description: Text-only fallback purchase flow for clients WITHOUT widget support. In ChatGPT prefer list_esim_plans / list_products + validate_order + create_order instead. Stateful: call repeatedly with the same session_token, answering one question at a time, until status is "complete". First call: empty argum

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "validate_order" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Dry-run an order and mint a one-time confirm_token (valid 10 minutes). Returns a human-readable summary that MUST be shown to the user for approval before calli…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
